job.job_description:
Key Accountabilities Activities

Assist in developing AI agents using both proprietary (e.g., OpenAI GPT) and open-source LLMs
(e.g., Qwen, Llama).

Implement ASR pipelines to support real-time speech-to-text use cases in meetings.

Contribute to model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and deployment for user-facing features.

Support the creation of QA and evaluation pipelines to monitor model accuracy and output quality.

Collaborate with product and engineering teams to align AI features with the overall product roadmap.

Conduct research on emerging ML/LLM techniques and experiment with integration into product use cases.

Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure reliable AI functionality.







Background, Skills Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field.

4+ years of experiences in ML and LLM.

Solid foundation in ML/DL principles and practical coding.

Proficiency in Python (bonus: JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or Java).

Familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras).

Exposure to LLM use cases and API integration.

Familiarity with ASR tools (e.g., Whisper, Vosk, Kaldi) is a plus.

Basic knowledge of cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure).

Comfortable working in a startup environment adaptive, fast-moving, and proactive.

Strong problem-solving skills, willingness to take ownership, and a growth mindset
